findings.text: The S-230-T3 closure record lacks the RRI, phase-1 review, Reflection, unit-coverage, and owner-verification evidence that the T4 dependency requires. Resolve that ledger inconsistency before implementation.
Freeze a reproducible base-image and Python/ffmpeg/faster-whisper dependency strategy in the T4 acceptance contract; the initial proposal did not constrain supply-chain drift.
State the resource/compatibility failure behavior for an explicitly selected ASR model size.
